hooks.prompt: Verify the git commit being made. Extract the commit message from $ARGUMENTS and check: (1) is it following conventional commits format, (2) does it accurately describe the changes, (3) are there any obvious issues? Report briefly: PASS if clean, or FLAG: [issue] if problems found.

Review the git push operation from $ARGUMENTS. Check: (1) is it pushing to an expected branch/remote, (2) are there any risky flags like --force, (3) is the timing appropriate (check if it's within market hours 09:00-15:30 IST for this trading repo). Report: PASS if safe, or WARN: [concern] if issues detected.
